items.source:
Creates a NearQuery starting near the given Point using the given Metric to adapt given values to further configuration. E.g. setting a maxDistance(double) will be interpreted as a value of the initially set Metric.
NOTE: There is a difference in using Point versus GeoJsonPoint. Point values are rendered as coordinate pairs in the legacy format and operate upon radians, whereas the GeoJsonPoint uses according to its specification meters as unit of measure. This may lead to different results when using a neutral Metric.
items.translation:
创建一个 NearQuery，该查询以给定的 Point 为中心，并使用给定的 Metric 来适配后续配置中的值。例如，设置 maxDistance(double) 将被解释为最初设置的 Metric 的值。
注意：使用 Point 与 GeoJsonPoint 存在差异。Point 的值以传统格式渲染为坐标对，并以弧度为单位进行操作，而 GeoJsonPoint 则根据其规范使用米作为度量单位。这在使用 neutral Metric 时可能导致不同的结果。

items.source:
Creates a new NearQuery starting at the given Point.
NOTE: There is a difference in using Point versus GeoJsonPoint. Point values are rendered as coordinate pairs in the legacy format and operate upon radians, whereas the GeoJsonPoint uses according to its specification meters as unit of measure. This may lead to different results when using a neutral Metric.
items.translation:
创建一个以给定的Point为起点的新的NearQuery。
注意：使用Point与GeoJsonPoint存在差异。Point的值以旧版格式的坐标对形式呈现，并以弧度为单位进行操作，而GeoJsonPoint则遵循其规范，以米作为度量单位。这在使用neutral Metric时可能导致不同的结果。

items.source: Sets the maximum distance to the given Distance. Will set the returned Metric to be the one of the given Distance if Metric was Metrics.NEUTRAL before.

items.source: Sets the minimum distance to the given Distance. Will set the returned Metric to be the one of the given Distance if no Metric was set before.
items.translation: 设置到给定 Distance 的最小距离。如果之前未设置 Metric，则将返回的 Metric 设置为给定 Distance 中的一个。

items.source: Will cause the results' distances being returned in the given metric. Sets distanceMultiplier(double) accordingly as well as spherical(boolean) if the given Metric is not Metrics.NEUTRAL.

items.source:
Sets the max distance results shall have from the configured origin. If a Metric was set before the given value will be interpreted as being a value in that metric. E.g. 
NearQuery query = near(10.0, 20.0, Metrics.KILOMETERS).maxDistance(150);
Will set the maximum distance to 150 kilometers.
items.translation:
设置结果与配置的起点之间的最大距离。如果在给定值之前设置了 Metric，则该值将被解释为在该度量单位下的数值。例如： 
NearQuery query = near(10.0, 20.0, Metrics.KILOMETERS).maxDistance(150);
这将把最大距离设置为 150 公里。

items.source:

Will set the minimum distance to 150 kilometers.
items.translation:
